decisions.reason: The homepage Requirement already records the supplied video as a temporary placeholder from message 96; message 98 does not necessitate any additional value or scope change.
Using a temporary video on the Home and Gallery pages does not change the source, count, or handling of the gallery photographs.
The temporary video decision does not change the requirement that homepage portfolio tiles link to the Gallery page.
Placement of the temporary video does not alter hover-animation behavior on homepage or gallery items.
The source decision places the video on the Gallery page but does not reintroduce a Videos category tab or otherwise change the existing category filters.
Using the video on the Home and Gallery pages does not change any homepage button destination.
The video asset's temporary status does not change the gallery's scrolling or interactive browsing behavior.
The video decision is unrelated to the mobile pricing table and its horizontal-scrolling behavior.
Using a temporary video does not modify the sourcing, selection, or replacement rules for site images.
The source places a portfolio video on the Home page but does not identify or modify the homepage hero image, overlay, or presentation.
The temporary portfolio video has no effect on the display or selection of individually priced services.
The video asset decision does not affect the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
